source_checks.finding: Fetched the search-returned address support.apple.com/en-gu/120000 (same article). Section 'If you're traveling internationally' says: 'If you're traveling internationally, make sure that your device is set up for data roaming.' Steps: 'Open the Settings app.' 'Tap Cellular or Cellular Data.' 'If your device has a single SIM card or eSIM, turn on Cellular Data, then tap Cellular Data Options.' 'Turn on Data Roaming.' Every step in the passage and target is on the page. The dual SIM branch is not used and is correctly unused.

Same article, section 'Contact your carrier' says: 'Issues with your carrier or account might affect your service. Contact your carrier to:' followed by a list (verify account is active, check coverage and outages, check device is not blocked, IMEI registration). The target uses only the first two sentences, which are on the page. The list is not used, which is acceptable for a fallback step.

required_actions.action: Open the Settings app and tap Cellular or Cellular Data
Turn on Cellular Data, then tap Cellular Data Options (single SIM or eSIM)
Contact your carrier if the account or service has an issue

source_checks.finding: Fetched the search-returned address support.apple.com/en-ie/102567 (same article). Section 'If your screen is too sensitive or responds intermittently to touch' says: 'Restart your iPhone or iPad.' and 'Make sure your screen is clean and free of any debris or water.' Both target steps are on the page. The page covers iPhone and iPad with no model limit.

Same section says: 'Disconnect any Lightning or USB-C accessories.' 'If your screen works after removing an accessory, try using a different socket, cable or charger.' 'Remove any cases or screen protectors.' The page says 'socket' where the target says 'outlet'; the meaning is the same, so this is not a finding. All steps are on the page.

Section 'Get support' says: 'If your screen still isn't working, you may need to set up a service for your device.' The target's wording is on the page. The page has no sentence about a screen that does not respond at all.

required_actions.action: Check that the screen is clean and free of debris or water
Disconnect Lightning or USB-C accessories and check whether the screen works
Remove any cases or screen protectors
Set up service for the device if the screen still does not work

findings: The target's second sentence says: 'They may not help a screen that does not respond at all.' The official page has no sentence about a screen that does not respond at all, so this caveat is not supported by the page.
correction_required: Replace the target's intro with: 'Your screen has stopped responding completely. Apple's steps below are for screens that are too sensitive or respond intermittently to touch.' Keep steps 1 to 6 unchanged.
